memoryBuilder.verseText: Whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock.

sequence.prompt: What did the two builders do? Put it in order.

items.label: Two men both decide to build a house
Wise man digs deep to the rock
Rock house stands — sand house falls

matches.prompt: Match each to what it means.

application.question: Jesus wants to be your foundation! What is one way you can listen to Jesus and DO what He says?

options.label: Be kind even when it's hard

application.followUp: When you build your life on Jesus — listening to Him and doing what He says — you will stand firm through anything.
